links.outcome: Expert-graded accuracy and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT glaucoma answers (1-4 scale)
links.effect: Mean panel score 3.29 (SD 0.484); 7 of 24 (29.2%) question-response pairs had mean inter-grader score of 3 or less, so most were adequate but a substantial minority incomplete or inaccurate.
links.quote: Out of the 24 question-response pairs, seven (29.2%) of them had a mean inter-grader score of 3 or less.

unlisted_practices: Prompting the LLM to self-correct poorly performing answers (mean score 2.96 to 3.58, p=0.001; full-score responses 30.6% to 57.1%)

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT on glaucoma patient questions and tests whether prompting the model to self-correct poor responses improves accuracy and safety.
